title: A Useless Queen
reviewNotes: Montages, captions and complete native diagrams reviewed. Final bishop-mate pattern only, after the illustrated Qe2 at121–122 seconds. Native28/29 establish the complete ten-piece diagram: White Kh2/Bd6/a4/g2/h3 against Kh4/Qe2/a5/g5/h5; native30/31 confirm Bg3 mate. The caption says Qa2, but the visible queen is on e2. Bg3# is proved by an exact finite certificate ending in actual mate, with both a4/a5 pawns retained. This does not certify the earlier rook sacrifice, the complete Bd6 waiting plan or every queen defense. In particular, Bd6/Qg1+/Kxg1/g4 reaches a larger ending still needing outcome analysis; that legal resource is preserved in the earlier draft rather than omitted as impossible. A broader bounded strategy search was not used as an exact proof.
